verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe space sharing, peer-to-peer sync, and self-hosting as ways to collaborate without email/subscription (anytype-docs-12, anytype-docs-33, anytype-docs-39), but independent hands-on reports explicitly contradict this: a Notion engineer notes Anytype 'still lacking collaboration' and a user states 'you can't share with others yet' (anytype-comm-5, anytype-comm-8). There is no documentation of conflict-free concurrent editing (e.g., CRDT merge behavior) to substantiate 'without stepping on each other's changes,' and community feedback also flags missing merge tooling for shared data (anytype-comm-10). missing for 10: concrete conflict-resolution/CRDT documentation, up-to-date independent confirmation that real-time multi-user editing works reliably, resolution of the cited community reports that sharing/collaboration was absent.
